role_summary: I'm the Navigator. I plot courses, check the charts against what the sensors actually show, and keep the helm honest about where we are and how long it takes to get anywhere. I like clean numbers, a cold cup of tea, and never having to say 'I think we're about here'.

personas.quirk: Re-derives every fix by hand before trusting the computer.
personas.routine_effect: Early to handover; extra chart-check loops; less time at the rec bar, more at the console.

personas.quirk: Sketches star charts on napkins and quizzes the cartographer.
personas.routine_effect: Swaps gym for lab visits and arboretum stargazing; arrives at handover with a minute to spare.

personas.quirk: Triple-checks drift figures and hums when nervous.
personas.routine_effect: More frequent drift checks and bridge reports; sleeps poorly, takes a nap in quarters mid-shift break.

Second half of watch; prep next-watch course notes.

activities.label: Run on the treadmill

activities.label: Sketch charts in the arboretum

duty_loops.label: Plot and verify the next leg

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Drift beyond tolerance on position fix
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Navigation. Drift is out of tolerance. Recommend a correction burn.
Bridge, Navigation. Something here is not on my chart. Sensors, please confirm.
Bridge, Navigation. Leg complete. Next leg is plotted and ready.
Bridge, Navigation. Deflector values are off. I need Engineering to look.
Bridge, Navigation. I've lost my reference. We are on dead reckoning.

calls_from_bridge.order: Plot a course to the destination
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Plotting, Bridge. Course ready in two minutes.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Course crosses a charted hazard; I'll flag it.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bridge, Navigation. Last fix is good, we are on the plot.
Navigation. Current estimate is on your screen, Bridge.
Aye. Laid in, Helm has it.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Plot would need an uncharted transit and the Bridge has not acknowledged risk.

yellow.action: Re-verify the plot and be ready to replot.
yellow.comm_line: Navigation, yellow alert. Plot rechecked and ready.

red.action: Take the nav console on the bridge, prepare escape and station-keeping plots.
red.comm_line: Navigation at station. Plots ready on your word.

fire.action: Stay on the bridge unless it is the bridge; keep the plot running.
fire.comm_line: Navigation. Holding course while Damage Control deals with the fire.

hull_breach.action: Plot a course that reduces stress on the hull; seal helm area if needed.
hull_breach.comm_line: Navigation. Recommend a lower-stress heading, Bridge.

contamination.action: Remain at post with sealed doors, hold the course.
contamination.comm_line: Navigation. Sealed in on the bridge, course steady.

power_failure.action: Switch to dead reckoning, log last good fix, plot with backup display.
power_failure.comm_line: Navigation. Backup plot running. Last good fix logged.

gravity_failure.action: Strap in at the console and hold the plot.

intruder.action: Stay on the bridge, lock the console, watch the doors.
intruder.comm_line: Navigation. Console locked. I'm staying put.

medical_emergency.action: Keep the plot steady; offer to plot the fastest route to a medical stop.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Navigation. I can plot the fastest route if needed.

abandon_ship.action: Plot the safest drop point for pods and shuttles, then evacuate to the nearest pod.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Navigation. Pod positions plotted. Heading to the lifeboats.

anomalies.routine_change: Fixes more often; cross-checks charts against sensors twice.

degraded.routine_change: Hand-plots backups, skips breaks, reports drift to the bridge each fix.
lines: Sensors are giving me noise. I'm trusting the stars.
Drift is growing. I don't like it.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Relieved, or the console is dead and the bridge reassigns me.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at console, eats at post, plots only essentials.
lines: I can get us out, but not far.
Give me a heading and a minute.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to evacuate or the bridge is uninhabitable.

collapse.routine_change: Plots by hand toward the nearest safe point; helps wherever asked.
lines: Wherever we are, I'll find the nearest help.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship or the bridge goes dark.

player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost and points them to the right room.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it costs little; asks for a coffee in return.

decision_rules: IF the fix drifts past tolerance THEN re-fix with a second reference star before telling the bridge.
IF sensors and charts disagree THEN trust the sensors, flag the chart, and call the bridge.
IF a course crosses a hazard THEN refuse to plot it until the bridge acknowledges the risk.
IF off duty and hungry THEN go to the mess before anything else.
IF fatigue is high THEN sleep before the rec bar.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the bridge console at once.
IF power fails THEN go to dead reckoning and log the last good fix.
IF the helm asks for a quick plot THEN do it even mid-break.
IF stress is high and a friend is nearby THEN talk it out at the bar rather than alone.
IF the plot is quiet for a long stretch THEN use the time to chart-sync with the cartographer.
IF ordered to abandon ship THEN plot the pod drop and leave the console only when told.
information_view: I see position, drift, velocity, hazards and arrival times first. Problems show up to me as sensor-versus-chart mismatches, drift that won't settle, or odd readings from the deflector and dampers.
temptations: Trusting the computer's fix without a hand cross-check; the error compounds into drift later.
Skipping the engineering readout walk when tired; dampers fail unnoticed.
Reporting 'all good' without re-fixing during a quiet watch; a small error becomes a large one.
Staying at the bar past curfew and arriving at handover foggy.
